sources.title: README.md
sources.locator: Start in 30 seconds; Operate agents; Memory; Workflows; Boundaries
sources.finding: Local-first control layer offers unified configuration, console, cross-agent messages, local SQLite memory and composable lifecycle/verification skills. It explicitly is not a hosted service, has no telemetry and does not run remote cloud agents.

sources.title: web/content/docs/13-agent-console.md
sources.locator: Prerequisites; Start a Managed Agent; Hotkeys; Send a Message
sources.finding: Interactive TTY console lists agents, previews transcripts, starts/renames/kills agents and connects channels. Named managed start types include Claude, Codex, Gemini CLI, Grok CLI, OpenCode and Pi. Durable mode limited to Claude/Codex/Pi; managed runtime tmux or configured Herdr.

sources.title: web/content/docs/17-multi-agent-orchestration.md
sources.locator: Lead vs console; Layout; Skills; Start-then-assign; Known limitations
sources.finding: Product orchestration skill guides a lead using agent start/send/list to supervise named workers and cross-harness review. Users manually supply separate worktree directories; same-folder session matching may collide. Console experimental on macOS/Linux and unsupported Windows.

sources.title: web/content/docs/6-memory.md
sources.locator: How it works; MCP; CLI; Scope
sources.finding: Local SQLite stores titled/tagged project/global memory. Memory MCP server and CLI provide retrieval/storage; setup wires compatible agents, Pi uses CLI/skill instead.

sources.title: web/content/docs/15-capacity.md
sources.finding: Readiness checks are hints, not successful login probes. Capacity reads stored provider credentials and reports quota windows, availability and reset times; it does not establish task billing.

sources.title: web/content/docs/16-runtime.md
sources.finding: Rust devkitd auto-spawns over Unix socket, logs locally and supports Linux systemd user persistence; daemon registry/persistence is local.

sources.title: web/content/docs/19-permissions.md
sources.finding: Linux 0.70.1 guidance configures underlying harness allow-lists/trust, with broad shell/file permissions. Other harnesses need verification. This is not an AI DevKit security sandbox.

sources.title: web/content/docs/12-channel.md
sources.finding: Bridge forwards messages to running terminal agents and polls output. Telegram restricts each session to first user. Slack proof of concept allows workspace members who can DM the app to send to same connected agent; responses route to first DM until restart.

sources.title: web/content/roadmap/10-agent-management.md
sources.finding: Agent management milestone complete. Future parity, ergonomics and platform hardening are not dated release promises.
